response.sql:
WITH filtered_results AS (
    SELECT cr.raceId, cr.points, r.name as raceName
    FROM constructorResults cr
    JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE cr.points > 1.0
),
per_race_stats AS (
    SELECT raceId, raceName, AVG(points) as perRaceAverage, COUNT(*) as resultCount
    FROM filtered_results
    GROUP BY raceId, raceName
),
race_name_averages AS (
    SELECT raceName, AVG(perRaceAverage) as raceNameAverage
    FROM per_race_stats
    GROUP BY raceName
)
SELECT prs.raceId, prs.raceName, prs.perRaceAverage, prs.resultCount,
       prs.perRaceAverage / rna.raceNameAverage as ratio
FROM per_race_stats prs
JOIN race_name_averages rna ON prs.raceName = rna.raceName
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST, prs.raceId
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "higher side" of the 1.0 dividing line means > 1.0 (strictly greater), not >= 1.0. In standard usage, a dividing line separates two regions without including the boundary itself.

alternatives.interpretation: "higher side" could include the boundary: >= 1.0 instead of > 1.0
